stem: The marketing director asks: "If every touch on the way to an order counted the same, how would last month's revenue split across channels?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: 40% to the first touch, 40% to the last, 20% shared by the rest
All of an order's revenue to its last touch
An order's revenue / its number of touches, to each touch
All of an order's revenue to its first touch
